links.outcome: Readability grade level of ChatGPT vs specialist doctor answers to IBD patient questions
links.effect: Median 7th grade for both ChatGPT (Q1 7th, Q3 8th) and doctors (Q1 4th, Q3 8th); no significant difference (P=.09).
links.quote: Regarding readability, no statistical difference was found between the responses of specialist doctors (median: 7th grade; Q1: 4th grade; Q3: 8th grade) and those of ChatGPT (median: 7th grade; Q1: 7th grade; Q3: 8th grade) according to the Mann-Whitney U test (P=.09).

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of ChatGPT responses to specialist doctor responses on patient questions about inflammatory bowel disease without testing a deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
